responsibility: Implements the Go frontend statement IR and statement semantics, including traversal, import/export of inline statement bodies, type determination, lowering of high-level constructs such as range loops and switches, backend translation hooks, assignment analysis support, and AST dumping. It is the main execution point for representing and transforming Go control-flow and side-effecting operations from parse-stage forms into simpler IR suitable for backend generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the statement hierarchy declared in `statements.h`, including traversal, import/export of inline bodies, lowering of high-level statement forms, and backend/AST-dump behavior. Unlike `statements.h`, it is the executable semantics and transformations for statement nodes rather than the class declarations and factory surface.
